issues.detail: The Vietnamese 'chẳng qua' (not pass/not exceed) fails to capture the specific Greek construction 'μη παρελθη... μεχρις ου' (shall not pass... until). The Greek implies a temporal boundary: this generation will not pass away *until* these things happen. The Vietnamese phrasing makes it sound like an inability to surpass a point rather than a chronological sequence of events.
